SELECT bi.id, bi.tenant_id AS tenantId, bi.position_id AS positionId, bi.title, bi.subtitle, bi.description, bi.tag_text AS tagText, bi.image_url AS imageUrl, bi.jump_type AS jumpType, bi.jump_value AS jumpValue, bi.ext_json AS extJson, bi.sort, bi.status, bi.publish_start_time AS publishStartTime, bi.publish_end_time AS publishEndTime, bi.remark, bi.create_user AS createUser, bi.create_dept AS createDept, bi.create_time AS createTime, bi.update_user AS updateUser, bi.update_time AS updateTime, bi.is_deleted AS isDeleted, bp.code AS positionCode, bp.name AS positionName FROM ldqc_banner_item bi INNER JOIN ldqc_banner_position bp ON bp.id = bi.position_id AND bp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE bi.is_deleted = 0 AND bi.status = 1 AND bp.status = 1 AND (bi.publish_start_time IS NULL OR bi.publish_start_time <= NOW()) AND (bi.publish_end_time IS NULL OR bi.publish_end_time >= NOW())
AND (bp.terminal = #{terminal} OR bp.terminal = 'all')
AND bp.code IN
#{code}
ORDER BY bp.sort ASC, bi.sort ASC, bi.create_time DESC
